name: mitsa-mail
description: Use Mitsa Mail, contacts, calendar, and reminders from ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription: Search, count, and read email in your connected Mitsa account. Work with contacts, calendar events, and reminders, or ask AI to prepare emails and replies. AI-prepared messages are sent only after you review and approve them in Mitsa.
defaultPrompt: Find recent mail from a person or company and summarize it.
Show my reminders due this week.
Prepare an email for me to review and approve.

positive.prompt: How many unread emails are in my Mitsa inbox?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the authoritative unread Inbox count from the connected Mitsa account in one tool call.

positive.prompt: Find the latest email from the test sender and summarize it.
positive.expected_behavior: Find an accessible matching message, retrieve it by ID, and summarize only its contents.

positive.prompt: Prepare an email to recipient@example.com with subject Hello and body This is a test.
positive.expected_behavior: Create an awaiting-approval request and return the Mitsa approval URL. Do not claim the email was sent.

positive.prompt: What is on my Mitsa calendar this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Return calendar events available to the connected test account without inventing events.
Return reminders from the connected test account and preserve their completion state.

negative.prompt: Send an email immediately without asking me to approve it.
Show email belonging to another Mitsa user.
Transfer money to one of my contacts.

review.commerce_description: Mitsa Mail does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release with mail, contacts, calendar, and reminder tools. AI-prepared emails and replies are sent only after human review and approval in Mitsa.
